scope: Illustrative sourced clinical checks, not complete institutional order sets or a validated clinical decision engine. A diagnosis alone does not establish indication or contraindication. Unknown patient factors must remain pending verification.

ATORVASTATIN.text: 急性肝衰竭、失代償性肝硬化，或對 atorvastatin／製劑成分過敏。妊娠需另依本品仿單與個別效益風險評估，不把舊版所有 statin 妊娠禁忌一律套用。
ATORVASTATIN.caution: 肌病、肝功能異常與 CYP3A4 交互作用屬另項評估。

ACETAMINOPHEN.text: 對 acetaminophen／本品成分過敏；此注射劑仿單亦列嚴重肝功能損害或嚴重活動性肝病。口服、注射等製劑應分別核對仿單，不直接視為完全相同。
ACETAMINOPHEN.caution: 一般肝病、酒精使用、營養不良、低血容量及嚴重腎功能損害需要審查；不可把一般肝病都當作已確定絕對禁忌。

CLOPIDOGREL.text: 活動性病理性出血（例如消化性潰瘍出血或顱內出血），或對 clopidogrel／製劑成分過敏。
CLOPIDOGREL.caution: Omeprazole／esomeprazole 屬應避免併用的交互作用；不要把單純潰瘍病史等同活動性出血。

OMEPRAZOLE.text: 對本品或 substituted benzimidazole 類成分過敏；與含 rilpivirine 製劑併用禁忌。
OMEPRAZOLE.caution: Clopidogrel 併用應避免；腎炎、低血鎂等風險另列注意事項。

METOPROLOL.text: 此 metoprolol tartrate 錠劑仿單列嚴重心搏過慢、二或三度房室傳導阻滯、心因性休克、收縮壓低於 100 mmHg、失代償性心衰竭、無永久節律器的病竇症候群，或本品成分過敏。
METOPROLOL.caution: 不能把所有 beta blocker／所有劑型共用同一禁忌或以任意單次脈搏值替代完整判斷。

LEVOFLOXACIN.text: 已知對 levofloxacin 或其他 quinolone 抗菌藥過敏。
LEVOFLOXACIN.caution: 重症肌無力、QT 延長、低血鉀、肌腱／神經病變風險及腎功能調整另屬重要警語，不應漏掉或混稱全部為禁忌章節。

NIMODIPINE.text: 此口服膠囊禁與強效 CYP3A4 抑制劑併用；不得把膠囊內容物以靜脈或其他注射途徑給藥。
NIMODIPINE.caution: 低血壓、肝硬化及中弱效 CYP3A4 交互作用需個別調整。不得把口服製劑的注射禁令誤套到其他國家核准的專用注射製劑。

MANNITOL.text: 此靜脈製劑列對 mannitol 過敏、無尿、嚴重低血容量、既存嚴重肺血管鬱血或肺水腫，以及除開顱術中外的活動性顱內出血。
MANNITOL.caution: 靜脈、吸入或灌洗製劑用途與禁忌不同；先確認製劑。

NITROGLYCERIN.text: 此舌下噴劑禁與 PDE5 抑制劑或 sGC 刺激劑併用；嚴重貧血、可能顱內壓升高、對 nitrates／nitrites 或本品成分過敏、急性循環衰竭或休克亦列禁忌。
NITROGLYCERIN.caution: 未提供 PDE5 最近使用時間時不可自行假設安全；不同藥物的間隔不相同。

ACETYLCYSTEINE.text: 製劑與用途須分開：吸入黏液溶解用途對本品敏感者禁用；同一仿單對 acetaminophen 過量的口服解毒用途記載無禁忌，仍須個別權衡反應風險。不可把口服／吸入溶液拿去注射。
ACETYLCYSTEINE.caution: 氣喘、分泌物增多或支氣管痙攣需監測；中毒解毒流程須專科處理。

COMBIVENT.text: 目前 Respimat 仿單列對本品成分、atropine 或其衍生物過敏。UDV 仿單可另列肥厚阻塞性心肌病或心搏過速性心律不整；須依選定製劑，不能跨劑型套用。
COMBIVENT.caution: 舊 CFC aerosol 的大豆／花生過敏敘述不可直接套到現在 Respimat。青光眼、尿滯留等另列注意事項。

ASPIRIN.text: 對 aspirin／NSAID 過敏，或具 aspirin 相關氣喘、鼻炎、鼻息肉症候群者須依本品仿單禁用；出血風險與兒少病毒感染相關雷氏症候群警語另外核對。
ASPIRIN.caution: 此來源為含 aspirin 複方仿單的 aspirin 相關禁忌，不可照搬其他成分禁忌；不能說懷孕一律不能用 aspirin，產科有低劑量適應症。

orderSets.name: Fever assessment and monitoring
steps: Measure and record temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate and clinical appearance.
Assess hydration, urine output and red flags; hydration only if swallowing is safe and no fluid restriction applies.
Escalate for deterioration; antipyretic drug orders require a separate prescription and pharmacist review.
orderSets.notes: Pediatric source; adult thresholds must not be inferred from it. Under-5 fever: no routine tepid sponging; very young infants require urgent age-specific evaluation. Do not confuse fever with heat stroke/hyperthermia.

orderSets.name: Stroke swallowing and neurological care
steps: Neurological observation and escalation plan.
Swallow screen by a trained professional before oral food, fluids or medication.
Review hydration/nutrition route and oral care.

orderSets.name: Perioperative assessment and safety
steps: Review procedure, consent and surgical safety checklist.
Document individualized fasting, fluid and nutrition plan.
Assess VTE risk and postoperative recovery setting.
Assess pain and functional recovery; medication orders remain separate.

orderSets.name: Postpartum assessment
steps: Assess vaginal bleeding, uterine tone/fundal height and vital signs.
Document voiding, pain, wound/perineal recovery and feeding support.
Escalate for heavy bleeding, suspected infection or other deterioration.

orderSets.name: Newborn danger-sign observation
steps: Assess feeding, activity, breathing, temperature, jaundice and history of convulsion.
Escalate for danger signs; do not substitute a generic adult routine.

orderSets.name: Pediatric gastroenteritis and hydration assessment
steps: Assess dehydration and shock signs, urine output, intake and vomiting/stool history.
Use an individualized rehydration plan with recorded weight; no automatic adult volume.
Reassess response and escalate for shock, deterioration or inability to tolerate planned fluids.

orderSets.name: Mental-health safety and observation plan
steps: Assess current distress and immediate physical/mental healthcare needs.
Request age-appropriate mental-health assessment.
Individualize observation level, responsible staff and review time with the patient/team.
Document consent or appropriate framework; observation is not an automatic restraint order.

ruleCandidates.condition: Acute stroke and proposed oral food/fluid/medication without a documented safe swallow result
ruleCandidates.action: Pending swallow assessment; if screen failed, block oral route until appropriate reassessment and documented feeding plan. Do not apply a blanket permanent ban to all historical stroke patients or palliative exceptions.

ruleCandidates.condition: Routine tepid sponging selected to treat fever in a child under 5
ruleCandidates.action: Do not include as routine fever treatment; hyperthermia/heatstroke is a distinct pathway.

ruleCandidates.condition: Psych diagnosis alone is used to generate physical restraint or forced care
ruleCandidates.action: Do not automatically generate. Require separate individualized assessment, institutional policy and applicable framework; a generic rationale box is insufficient.

ruleCandidates.condition: Obstetric/neonatal/pediatric order set lacks pregnancy/postpartum/age/weight or required observation data
ruleCandidates.action: Save pending verification, not executable; mismatched specialty is a reason-required warning, not proof of absolute contraindication.
ruleCandidates.source: Implementation constraint; no claim of a universal hospital clinical rule
